characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: A sturdy leather apron dyed deep brown with worn patches at the elbows and cuffs, cinched to her waist by a thick cord. Underneath, she wears a plain linen shirt in muted cream, sleeves rolled up to mid‑bicep. Her trousers are dark woolen breeches that fall just below the knee, tucked into sturdy leather boots polished to a shine. A simple brass belt holds a small pouch and a wooden mug holder. The apron’s front features a pocket for tools, while her wrists are wrapped in faded blue cloth bands
